meta.title: UI Motion
meta.description: Adds a dithered signal-field backdrop to the new-session and chat pages, a blueprint headline plus ASCII whale animation on the new-session page, and frosted glass for the composer — each page has its own switches, and every effect is tunable under Settings → UI Motion.

runtime.title: UI motion
runtime.lead: Settings are per page: the new-session page and the chat page each have their own switches. Changes apply instantly and are stored in this browser.
runtime.masterHint: When off, no canvas, no animation loop and no injected styles: the UI returns to the stock DSH look.
runtime.rowFpsHint: Caps how often the signal field and whales redraw; lower saves more power. The field drops to 8 fps while the window is unfocused and returns to the display rate during pointer interaction.
runtime.pageHeroHint: When off, the new session page returns to the stock DSH look (backdrop, headline, whales, composer glass and the HUD panel backing field all stop).
runtime.pageChatHint: When off, the chat page returns to the stock DSH look (backdrop, composer glass and the HUD panel backing field all stop).
runtime.rowBackgroundHint: Whether this page shows the signal field; when off this page shows no backdrop, and the HUD panel's backing field and glass turn off with it (headline, whales and composer glass are unaffected).
runtime.rowBackgroundIdleHint: The noise wave drifts on its own; when off the signal field is static but still visible.
runtime.rowBackgroundInteractHint: Cursor erase (light theme) / light-up (dark theme) and click ripples.
runtime.rowIntensityHint: Only changes how dense the signal field is, not its speed; 30% by default.
runtime.rowBackgroundSpeedHint: Flow speed of the whole backdrop: wave drift, ripple wobble and ripple spread all scale together, and ripples live correspondingly shorter; 1× is the current feel. Independent of the redraw cap — high speed with a low cap looks steppy.
runtime.rowTitleHint: Replaces the stock DSH headline with the blueprint headline; when off the stock text returns.
runtime.rowTitleIdleHint: Letter-by-letter reveal and sweep on entry; when off the headline is static.
runtime.rowTitleInteractHint: Glyphs turn into dashed outlines near the pointer and can be dragged; when off it ignores the pointer.
runtime.rowTitleSpeedHint: How fast the sweep runner, reveal lens and hover-to-outline transitions run; 1× is the current feel. Applies live while dragging, with no replay.
runtime.rowWhaleHint: Stacks an ASCII whale layer on the new-session page, above the signal field.
runtime.rowWhaleSpeciesHint: Humpback has longer flippers and wider flukes; orca is slightly smaller with white markings.
runtime.whaleNumbersHint: These apply immediately. Changing species, whale count, size, cell size or fish count rebuilds the whole ocean; the rest update in place without replaying.
runtime.rowGlassHint: Frosted glass on the composer card and its backing; the blur radius is fixed at 14px.
runtime.detailLocked: Turn the switch above on for these settings to take effect.
runtime.reducedMotion: The system asks for reduced motion, so animation and pointer interaction are off by default; you can still switch them on here.
runtime.titleUnavailable: This DSH build exposes no headline mount point on the new session page, so headline effects are unavailable.
